final.role: Store embeddings and run approximate nearest-neighbor semantic search
final.evidence: 埋め込みベクトルを保存し、近似最近傍探索（ANN）を用いて意味検索を実現する仕組み。

auditoria.nota: This is the core of semantic search. For a personal vault, an embedded HNSW store (FAISS, Chroma, sqlite-vec) is enough; a Milvus server is overkill.
